user.title: Discovered machines
user.description: Machines announcing themselves on your network. The status API must be enabled in the firmware (`config-set sd wifi.http_enable true`).

manual.title: Machine address
manual.description: No machine was discovered (it may be powered off). Enter the address manually — the machine must be on to finish setup.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the status API. Check the machine is on and `wifi.http_enable` is set to true in the firmware.
